append.detail: ── SUPERSEDED 2026-10-06 by ADR-1709 (LIVE-748). The meter numbers this probe pinned were changed by the owner's five-tier ladder, so it now fails by design. Original probe, kept verbatim: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const note=fs.readFileSync("lib/spaces/people-catalog-note.ts","utf8");if(!note.includes("export function peopleCatalogNote"))fail("peopleCatalogNote is gone");if(!note.includes("PLACEHOLDER_METER_LIMITS.space_team"))fail("people catalog note does not read the seat meter");if(!note.includes("SPACE_PLAN_LABEL.business"))fail("people catalog note does not name Business from the plan label");if(/Collective/.test(note))fail("people-catalog-note still types Collective");const cat=fs.readFileSync("lib/admin/modules/space-modules.ts","utf8");if(!cat.includes("peopleCatalogNote()"))fail("space.people no longer reads peopleCatalogNote");if(/1 seat free, 3 included on Collective/.test(cat))fail("space.people still names 3 Collective seats");const meters=fs.readFileSync("lib/pricing/meter-limits.ts","utf8");if(!/space_team:\s*\{\s*free:\s*1,\s*business:\s*2\s*\}/.test(meters))fail("space_team left the 1/2 ladder");console.log("LIVE-435 ok")'
